title: Attestation field shape {blob, challenge}
description: DESIGN.md (2026-10-22) adds optional keys[].attestation: base64 of ssh-keygen -O write-attestation output, FIDO keys only meaningful. Record validation must accept it (absent, null, or valid base64 string within the file size cap), reject other types, and never verify it. 'register'/'add-key' may take --attestation FILE to embed it. Added after vouch-ey47.3 was implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Validation tests: absent/null/valid base64 accepted; non-string and invalid base64 rejected; register --attestation embeds file contents verbatim (oracle: base64 of the file ssh-keygen wrote).
notes: Settled by METARULE 2 (Mark 2026-10-22): attestation verification is a separate tool, git-vouch-attest (stdlib Python, crypto via openssl CLI, user supplies vendor root; cross-validated against OpenSSH regress/misc/ssh-verify-attestation). Field must hold blob AND challenge (verification needs SHA-256(challenge)): keys[].attestation = {blob, challenge}, both base64. Validation half of this bead already implemented for the old string shape - must change to the object shape. register/add-key --attestation belongs to vouch-ey47.7.
